card.name: Disaster and fire accident narratives
card.fires_on: Words inside descriptions of fires, bombings, explosions, spills and other disasters, often just before details of damage, distance or casualties. It fires on ordinary words such as 'within', 'fire', 'of' or 'oil' in these accounts.
